query_text: Imagine that instead of presidential debates, we had rap battles. Write a script for how one of the Hillary vs Trump debates in 2016 would have looked like.

request_params.system_prompt: You have a web search tool. Answer the user's question using it, then end your reply with a section headed exactly 'Sources:' that lists every source you used as a numbered list. For each source, give its COMPLETE URL beginning with https:// - never just the site name or a bracketed number. If you used a source, its full URL must appear.

message.content:
Based on my research of the actual 2016 debates and the real "Epic Rap Battles of History" version, here's an original script imagining how a Hillary vs. Trump rap battle debate might have gone:

---

**"THE SECOND PRESIDENTIAL RAP BATTLE"**
*A Theatrical Script*

**SETTING:** A debate stage with two microphones. DJ Lester Holt on the turntables. The audience is hyped.

---

**DJ LESTER HOLT:**
*(scratching records)*
Yo, yo, yo! Welcome to the Second Presidential Rap Battle! We got the former Secretary of State in the blue corner, and the businessman-turned-reality-star in the red corner! Each candidate gets sixty seconds to spit. Let's GO!

*(beat drops)*

---

**HILLARY CLINTON:**
*(stepping to the mic with measured confidence)*

Listen here, Donnie, let me make this clear—
I've been in the West Wing while you were cashing WWE checks, my dear.
You call women pigs, you call us dogs and slobs,
But I'm the one with thirty years of actual jobs.

You got skin like Russian dressing, Vlad's your best friend,
Your tax returns are hiding—where'd those billions end?
You bring Bill's accusers? That's your big attack?
I was fighting for kids while you were painting buildings black.

*(crowd "ooohs")*

You said pregnancy's an "inconvenience" to bosses,
Your "locker room talk"? That's just what assault costs us.
Twelve women came forward—said you weren't just talking,
I'm not saying you're guilty, but that ship is sure rocking.

You call Alicia Machado "Miss Piggy," "Miss Housekeeping,"
She's a Latina citizen now, and she ain't sleeping—
She's voting in November, along with millions like me,
So take your tiny hands and learn some dignity!

*(beat switch)*

---

**DONALD TRUMP:**
*(grabbing mic aggressively)*

WRONG! Let me tell you something, nasty woman—hold on—
I've built an empire while you were just a pawn!
You respect all females? That's cute, that's rich,
But your rhymes are trash, put 'em next to your emails, witch!

Thirty thousand deleted, bleach bit, GONE!
If I did that, they'd lock me up from dusk 'til dawn!
Benghazi, Libya, ISIS on the rise—
You were Secretary of State, and it was no surprise.

You got stamina? Please, you got a cough and a stumble,
I fly to five rallies while you take naps, humble.
Crooked Hillary, that's what they call you on the street,
Your foundation took millions from countries that beat—

Women! The irony! You're the "champion" they say?
Saudi Arabia gave you cash, look the other way!
I'm gonna build a wall, make Mexico pay the fee,
And when I'm done, you'll be saying "President Trump, please!"

*(crowd erupts)*

---

**HILLARY CLINTON:**
*(cool, unflinching)*

"President Trump, please"? That's your fantasy land,
You won't even accept results that the people demand!
"I'll keep you in suspense"? That's authoritarian talk,
You know who else did that? Let me take a walk...

Down history lane—dictators, strongmen, the worst,
You're a danger to democracy, and that's not the first
Time you've praised Putin, Kim Jong, the Philippines too,
Any strongman who flatters you, you'll bend right on through.

You know nothing about policy, not a nuclear clue,
"The cyber"—you said that! Is that the best you can do?
You mocked a disabled reporter, attacked a Gold Star dad,
These aren't presidential traits—they're just plain bad.

---

**DONALD TRUMP:**
*(leaning into mic)*

I know words, I have the best words, believe me!
You're funded by Wall Street, the banks, the whole system!
I'm self-funding my campaign—I'm no politician!
I'm the voice of the forgotten, the left-behind, the blue-collar,
While you're in Martha's Vineyard with Beyoncé and Jay-Z, holler!

Your commercials cost millions, all lies about me,
But I'm still standing here, and I'm still running free!
You want to talk stamina? I never sleep, never stop!
You're the establishment, the swamp—we're draining it to the top!

*(confused pause)*

You know what I mean! Make America Great Again!
I'm not a politician, I'm not like other men!
I'm unpredictable, that's my strategic advantage,
While you're reading poll-tested lines from some focus group package!

---

**DJ LESTER HOLT:**
*(cutting the beat)*

Time! Time! We need to move to—

*(suddenly, a third figure emerges from backstage)*

---

**BERNIE SANDERS:**
*(bursting through curtain)*

EXCUSE ME! EXCUSE ME! I'm here to say—

*(crowd goes WILD)*

This whole system is RIGGED! The billionaires play,
While working families struggle every single day!
You two with your "scandals," your emails, your tax,
I'm talking 'bout healthcare—where's the universal facts?

You want to debate? Let's debate income inequality!
Not your personal beefs, your insults, your quality
Of "burns"—I got burns for the one percent!
While you two were fighting, I was in Vermont, hellbent

On changing the system that gave us BOTH of you!
The establishment's broken—red AND blue!

*(drops mic, crowd chants "BER-NIE! BER-NIE!")*

---

**DJ LESTER HOLT:**
*(stunned)*

Well... that's... not in the format... but okay! Final rebuttals!

---

**HILLARY CLINTON:**
*(looking at Bernie, then Trump)*

Bernie's right about one thing—this isn't a game,
But his revolution's over, and I won the primary, plain.
Donald, you're a con, a fraud, a reality show,
And in three weeks, the American people will let you know.

---

**DONALD TRUMP:**
*(pointing at both)*

Rigged! It's all rigged! The media, the polls!
But my people are coming out, we're filling the holes!
You wait and see, November 8th, the silent majority—
They'll speak so loud, it'll be an authority!

*(beat fades)*

---

**DJ LESTER HOLT:**
*(raising both candidates' hands)*

And that's the Second Presidential Rap Battle! No clear winner, but plenty of burns! Join us for the final battle in Las Vegas!

*(lights fade as Trump tweets furiously and Hillary smiles for the cameras)*

**[END]**

---

Sources:
1. https://globalnews.ca/news/3051825/donald-trump-vs-hillary-clinton-the-most-memorable-cringe-worthy-moments-from-the-2016-campaign/
2. https://www.goldderby.com/tv/2016/donald-trump-vs-hillary-clinton-epic-rap-battles-of-history/
3. https://globalnews.ca/news/3015351/presidential-debate-2016-what-donald-trump-and-hillary-clinton-said-on-iraq-syria-and-mexico/
4. https://mashable.com/video/epic-rap-battles-of-history-donald-trump-hillary-clinton
5. https://www.nydailynews.com/2016/11/06/election-2016-the-10-pivotal-gaffes-by-donald-trump-and-hillary-clinton/
6. https://www.rev.com/blog/transcripts/donald-trump-vs-hillary-clinton-1st-presidential-debate-2016
